_about: THE WATER LILY (Nymphaea): round leathery pads, each slit to its middle, flat on still water; among them waxy cups of many pointed petals, white or pink, round a golden heart. Its LOOK, painted into the flowers' atlas (plants/flowers.js): petal / petal2 / centre / leaf / spike -- shape, colours (a list: one a variant), throat, veins and touches. How it GROWS -- stem, leaves, blooms and their sizes -- is its recipe in plants/flowers.js (GROW).
